body:
feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. my note below says saltlike grains came from the livestock supplement test; my sister coughed all night before warning tape went up.

We kept one copy for ourselves. The person collecting the other one said the numbers would be corrected later, once everyone had moved.

Someone had to finish the household list even though the office had closed. I wrote the names in the space left for expenses.
title: cab receipt before sunday's rain

body: At the bend they made us wait for a lead car before letting anyone through. The lead car never returned. The man who kept the count quietly drew a line through everyone still waiting when the road filled up.
title: Last fuel stop
